description: Return URLs cited by an AI engine (Perplexity, Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or Bing) for a query. Use this when an agent or user wants to see what sources an AI search engine grounds answers on. Requires at least one engine API key; auto-picks the first available.

engine.description:
Engine to query.
• perplexity / google_ai_mode — consumer_scrape: closest to real product behavior.
• claude / openai / gemini — api_proxy: API-tier call, may differ from consumer product.
• bing_serp / brave_serp — web_rank: traditional SERP rank, NOT LLM citation.
'auto' prefers SerpAPI (google_ai_mode) → Perplexity → LLM adapters → web_rank.

perplexity_model.description: Perplexity model override (e.g. 'sonar', 'sonar-pro', 'sonar-reasoning'). Only used when engine='perplexity'. Defaults to 'sonar-pro'.

query.description: The search query to test (what would a user ask an AI?)

name: citations_check

cached.description: Whether the result was served from the local cache.

title.description: Page title as returned by the engine.

fetched_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of the fetch.

interpretation_note.description: Guidance on how to interpret results from this engine.

raw_answer.description: Raw answer text from the engine, if available. Absent for web_rank engines (bing_serp, brave_serp) that return ranked URLs without a synthesized answer.

surface.description: Engine surface type: consumer_scrape, api_proxy, or web_rank.
